items.target: Zora Labs, a Delaware company founded in 2020 and led by chief executive Jacob Horne, runs it.
items.why: Jacob Horne's own post of 2026-09-09 says cofounder Dee Goens is taking over as CEO, so the sentence's 'led by chief executive Jacob Horne' is out of date (L34 was accurate for its source).
items.final_text: Zora Labs, a Delaware company founded in 2020, runs it; Jacob Horne said cofounder Dee Goens is taking over as chief executive.

lines.text: The X account @js_horne (named Jacob, linking jacob.energy) posted on 2026-09-09 that cofounder Dee Goens (@dg_goens) is taking over as CEO at Zora.
lines.quote: My cofounder @dg_goens is taking over as CEO at Zora.

affects.target: Zora Labs, a Delaware company founded in 2020 and led by chief executive Jacob Horne, runs it.

notes: Only the post is a claim: X is not a channel on zora.co and has no strong tie, and the tweet text was read through fxtwitter (the x.com page only gave a title/meta snippet). The post says Dee Goens is taking over as CEO; it does not literally say Horne 'stepped down', so final_text says 'taking over' rather than the visitor's wording. Not independently confirmed by a zora.co source; Zora's own site was not checked for an update. Nothing was inferred about the identity behind the account beyond its public handle and name.
